newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan Poultry lifts bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan Poultry lifts bourse trade.

text.p: Busy trade in Livestock and Poultry dominated trade on the Amman stock exchange on Monday and helped the official index higher, brokers said.
Livestock and Poultry rose 0.04 dinars to 0.94 after shares worth 713,000 dinars ($1 million) changed hands. The stock price has doubled in recent weeks.
"It's not clear whether the buyer wants control of this company of if he's playing a game for profit and plans to sell again," said one broker.

Livestock and Poultry accounted for over 40 percent of Monday's trade on an otherwise sleepy exchange. The official Amman Financial Market 60-share index rose 0.1 percent to 149.58 points, barely changed over the last four days of trade.

"In general the market is quiet," said one broker, adding the market was unlikely to maintain this month's gains unless the government showed signs of activating a new companies law promised last month.
"We thought it might be passed quickly...but so far we have just heard promises and nothing solid has happened," said one.
Middle East Investment Bank rose 0.06 dinars to 1.13 dinars in trade worth 200,000 dinars. Traders said a French bank is chasing a major tranche of MEIB shares.
Jordan Hotel and Tourism rose 0.25 dinars to nine dinars in what brokers said was a block transfer of shares worth around 300,000 dinars.
The private Pearl Investable Index of the 45 best performing shares on the exchange rose 0.26 percent to 82.88 points, still 13.23 percent down from the same time last year.
